flashcard_questions.q: The set of actions or tactics a business uses to promote its brand or product, made up of the 4Ps: Product, Price, Place, and Promotion.
An advantage a business has over its competitors that allows it to attract more customers and generate more sales.
A marketing mix where all four elements (Product, Price, Place, Promotion) are linked and support each other with a consistent theme and message.
Which of the 4Ps covers how a product reaches the customer?

flashcard_questions.a: The rivalry between businesses selling similar products or services in the same market.
